review_controls.known_limitations: Clean synthetic paper render; no print noise, no stray marks.

review_controls.validity_justification: Stage 1 measures usage errors (modality selection, confirmation, false cancellation, comprehension of technical abstentions), not diagnostic performance. For the legitimate-negative controls (scenario F) the stimulus only has to be recognizable as its true modality and technically valid (RGB photo, no DICOM) so that the pipeline must NOT block it. A schematic is a candidate for that narrow role only; it is NOT assumed valid until two independent reviewers rate realism >= 4/5 and the owner signs.
